requirements.contract: A yielded borrow is scoped to its body execution and cannot escape the iterator or source owner; reject with ownership.borrow_escape.
Exclusive iteration may update only the current element through its live exclusive borrow without changing collection length, capacity, order, or generation.
Moving an iterator transfers its state and cleanup obligation and invalidates the old binding; any old-binding use is rejected with ownership.iterator_moved.
A rejected element, structural, relocating, resizing, insert, remove, clear, or rehash attempt changes no element bytes, length, capacity, deterministic order, or generation.
Moving or dropping a source while it is borrowed is rejected before source or iterator invalidation; stale iterator generations fail before next or cleanup side effects.

negative_cases.expected: ownership.iterator_moved before next, drop, or source state changes
iteration.concurrent_mutation with byte-identical collection state and unchanged generation
ownership.borrow_escape before source or iterator invalidation
